seoTitle: Add Video to Hostinger Website Builder (2026)
metaDescription: Embed a YouTube video or upload your own video file into a page using the Hostinger website builder.
intro: Adding video content to your Hostinger site is a quick way to make a page more engaging, whether you're embedding a YouTube video or uploading your own file. This guide covers finding the video element and placing it on your page.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Sign in to your account and open the website builder for the site you want to edit.

steps.heading: Find the video element
steps.body: In the builder's element panel, look for the Video option among the available content blocks.

steps.heading: Add your video
steps.body: Drag the video element onto your page, then choose to embed a YouTube link or upload a video file directly.

steps.heading: Adjust size and placement
steps.body: Resize and reposition the video block so it fits well within your page layout.

steps.heading: Save and publish
steps.body: Save your changes and publish the page so the video is live for visitors to watch.

faq.question: Can I embed a YouTube video directly in Hostinger's builder?
faq.answer: Yes, the video element supports embedding a YouTube link directly onto your page.

faq.question: Can I upload my own video file instead of using YouTube?
faq.answer: Yes, the builder also supports uploading your own video file directly rather than embedding from an external source.

faq.question: Do I need to resize the video after adding it?
faq.answer: You can adjust its size and placement in the builder so it fits cleanly within your page's layout.

faq.question: Will the video autoplay for visitors?
faq.answer: This depends on your video block's settings — check the element's options to control autoplay behavior.
